batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c D Ferreira b Yash Raj Punja

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b Akash Singh

batting.name: V Suryavanshi
batting.dismissal: c Abdul Samad b Mohsin Khan

balls.text: someone get Archer another gold chain, what an over, what a yorker! Badoni goes across but it doesn't matter because the ball hits the base of off stump and the sparse crowd loves it

another run out in the final over, Marsh is gone for 96 looking for that second run and Jurel's quick glove work finishes his innings. Low full toss slammed down to long off, Jaiswal is quick with his pick up, flat throw to the keeper's end and dislodges top of off with a direct hit

149.5kmh, Marsh is beaten by pace but such is his luck, thick edge runs away for four wide of short third. It was a full toss around the waist so Marsh reviews this too. All eyes on the big screen. It's just under the waist, graphic shows so legal delivery

it's time for RR to review as Marsh misses the third ball in a row! Or does he have an edge off the short of length ball off his pull? UltraEdge is quicker to load and there's nothing on it. "Flat line" as they say

143.9kmh, another bouncer with pace on. This one outside off and Marsh misses again but reviews this time for a wide. The graphic is being loaded, please don't go anywhere. Here it is and it's not over the head, dot ball

Archer nails it all and sends Pant back! Sharp bouncer at 148kmh which Marsh doesn't connect with, Pant sprints down for one but Marsh doesn't move. Meanwhile Jurel throws the ball to Archer who smashes the stumps down at his end
swings with a horizontal bat, pace off again, and only one off the inside edge
rolls his fingers over that, 123.1kmh, it cuts in off the pitch, goes under the bat to the keeper and they sneak in a bye despite a clean collection by Jurel
A straight bat six from Pant! Full toss around the shins and Pant swings of the hills, for a change without moving much
slow bouncer makes Pant wait for a lifetime before he tries to reach out. He doesn't but it's a wide for the height
low and dipping full toss, slams it back to Mishra
Marsh skies one more, this one doesn't even go beyond the circle and nobody gets to it! IT was headed towards cover, and Jaiswal ran in but was beyond him. Lucky for Marsh there was no cover point
143.4kmh, short ball and he connects enough only for one down the ground

149.1kmh, keeps nailing his yorkers and even though this isn't in the block hole, it's very difficult to put it away. Angling in with pace on, almost between Marsh's legs and he gets an edge for a boundary fine on leg
shuffles across, connects this time with the yorker and finds a single on leg
a tad wider, again outside his arc and another miss for Pant
low and wide full toss now, Pant misses this time

cheeky Pant does cheeky things again, and this time loses his balance. So back to normal for him. Goes across, leaning diagonally towards off for the full delivery and he nearly scoops it on the stumps! But it's gone between his legs and leaves Archer laughing
Archers nails the yorker too, on leg stump, and Marsh rams it into his front foot for one

a typical Pant shot, except he doesn't lose balance. In the block hole on off, nothing wrong with that ball, but Pant goes across, gets his body leaning behind that on just his left leg and flicks it over backward square leg! Stunning execution
low full toss on the tram line again, Marsh anticipates it but he can only drive it to cover
he tries to do it again, crosses the tram line this time but Marsh also shuffles across to off so wide not given
goes for the wide yorker, Marsh gets a bottom edge off the low full toss
doesn't matter what field you set because if Marsh middles it, it's going to clear any boundary. Length ball outside off, he moves towards the ball and smacks it over wide long on
slow ball banged into the pitch, hammered back down to long off
nicely delivered in the block hole and Marsh digs it out, back to the bowler
high full toss and mowed just over short fine leg! That was pretty high over the waist towards leg and Marsh did well to adjust to the pace and help it along over the leaping fielder in the circle
tries to keep it outside Marsh's arc with a wide one and it's just outside the line
width outside off now and he slams it down to long off

Pant finally connects and sends that all the way! Slower ball off the back of the hand, a bit too short and Pant takes a step down to transfer that momentum into the ball and send it crashing over wide long on
slower ball almost drifting in, Pant goes big again but finds deep backward square where Mishra does well to save two with a tumble
nearly yorks him, Marsh bunts it down to long on too
slow and full, a mighty swing straight down along the ground and they get one
excellent end to an excellent spell, another tight ball outside off and Pant gets one through the covers region
nice and straight with no room whatsoever, Marsh is forced to tap it to leg once he goes on the back foot. Just one
92.4kmh, just back of length and barely any room, Pant rocks back to cut it away
perhaps a tad short and Marsh muscles it square with a pull but straight to the fielder
90.3kmh, nicely looped outside off, Marsh waits and pushes to cover
brave line way outside leg to Pant, fizzy turn and he taps it to leg for another single
the slower ball comes in and Pant helps it along for one
excellent ball. Right in the block hole around fourth stump at 139kmh and he can't get bat on it
nicely done by Brijesh. Pant dances down towards leg for a big swing and Brijesh keeps it out his reach on off with a slower one at 109kmh
136.7kmh, angling in on the pads with pace again, can't quite connect but they get a leg bye
straight full toss at 140kmh, and Marsh probably wasn't expecting pace, a tad late on the push back
flirting with the wide line, crosses the limit and pays the price of a wide
slower ball swinging in towards his feet, clipped off the pad for Pant's third single
nice and tight on middle, Marsh clips it to leg from short of length with soft hands so that they can return for two
another googly towards off, he hangs back and pulls behind square this time
sliding in with the arm towards leg, tucked to leg for one more
gets a slightly short ball and Pant goes low to pull it square. Off the mark

and Yash Raj delivers again! Decent pace at 94.8kmh, turning away again from good length and Pooran doesn't quite middle it while going down town and this time Ferreira does well to hold on over his head. Sigh of relief for him
thick edge off a mighty pull, and Pooran nearly chopped off there! Looked like a wrong'un towards off and kept a bit low too, went fine on the leg side
ends the over with two fours in a row! Sushant loses his length after starting the over well, and Marsh uses his muscle and might to pull that short ball for four more
138.6kmh, that's not a bad ball at all, just around off stump. But Marsh deftly uses the pace of the ball for a late dab bisect short third and point. Excellent timing
another one with pace off, 122.3kmh, this one on leg and goes off the pad to the keeper. Another heave and miss
good reply from Mishra for the slow and short ball out of his reach, Marsh swings and misses

misfield at long off that's four instead of one! RR's demons of misfields from the last game haven't left Jaipur. Marsh smashed this down to long off where Ferreira tumbled to his left and the ball deflected off his hands. He puts his hand up for an apology
here's Sushant and here's another wide, well, almost. This one stays just inside the line despite the left-arm over angle
nearly in the block hole, driven down to long on where there's another fumble but they don't return for the second
just inside the wide line now, full and slow again and Pooran goes for a flourishing drive into the covers for one
he bowls to his field, full and wide outside off without much pace, but it's a wide

the slow bouncer almost does the trick because Marsh has skied this on the leg side. Not much pace on the ball, not much distance off the bat and Pretorious comes springing in from deep midwicket but his forward dive is also not enough
bangs the cutter into the pitch well outside off, inside the tram line and Marsh spares it
like a replay, this is full and slow again, except it's hit much harder and beats long on for four. That's a fifty off 25 balls for Marsh
starts slow at 106.4kmh, pretty full and Marsh drills it straight back for two because of the fumble
Back of a length and angled back into Pooran. Glides it down to backward point. Great comeback once his nerves settled
full-ish and kept fairly wide of off. Pooran crouches as he leans into a thrash of a drive, but ball runs under his bat

Pooran has not timed this and he's somehow got six runs to his name. Was banged in a little too short, rose at Pooran right outside off. He waits for it deep inside his crease and lofts this over the deep square leg boundary
Slower 'un. Makes Marsh wait for another swipe across the line, kept well outside off from a hard length. Bunted down to long on
137 clicks again. Rifles into a hard length and shoots past Marsh's attempt at a huge swipe across the line. Now he's looking quite quick... He can make the delivery skid through, really useful

Finally on a good line, and it's actually great. 137.8 clicks that rise at Pooran and thuds into his hips. Runs over to the other end and Pooran throws his head back in angst, he knows he might have missed out there, got rushed on the shot
Third time isn't the charm... Pushed in just a little fuller, but angled down leg side. This angle over the stumps and to the left-hander is messing with his radar here
140.7 kph. More pace, same result. Short ball banged into the pitch and sliding down leg once more
137 kph but of no use, because this short ball slants down leg side and past Pooran's hoick at it. Time to reload
After all that in the over, a single to finish it off. On a length at the stumps, flicked down to long-on without too much fuss
Now that's more like it from the Pooran we know. Was floated up too full, outside off. Gets down on one knee and uses the room to throw his hands at a lofted drive, through the line
On a length and spins away from the left-hander. Pooran leaves this one alone
Nicky P goes for a huge swipe, swishes at air. Was floated up once more, he looks to swipe this across the line, off a good length, but thuds into the pads again

That's one way to come back! Punja does the brave thing: lobs this up fuuuull, and just deceives Inglis through the air. Batter was on one knee and wanted to swipe it over deep midwicket. But he just gets deceived in the air and loses his stumps. Punja plays it cool, hardly a reaction. Narine writ all over that non-celebration
Lofted drive is impeccably placed! Was back of a length, sat up near the stumps for Inglis to just shuffle into the leg side and time this to perfection. Past the diving deep extra cover
Now that's more like it, for LSG. Back of a length and sitting up for that classic Marsh swipe across the line. Pulled over the deep square boundary

Falls short of deep midwicket and cow corner, both running in! Was there to be hit but was a little slower than Inglis expected. 112 clicks to deceive Inglis, who reaches for this and mistimes a lofted flick
Speared into the blockhole, now defended out to covers
Sloooow, on a length at the stumps. Marsh can only bunt a defense back to the bowler's left
Driven in the air, and straight down the ground. Was speared in quite full, at the stumps, and Inglis runs to the other end
Low full toss, driven down to deep extra cover
Good comeback, this, mini as it is. On a length outside off, driven down to covers once more
Kept wider. On a short-ish length still. Driven down to covers, not much drama on that one
Marsh has just muscled this one over deep midwicket. Sits up on a perfect length. Marsh sits back in his crease as ball spins into him. Then he just middles this swipe, and another six it is
Finally on a good length. Spins away from in front of the stumps to the right-hander. Defended down to covers
Another short-ish delivery. Now he pulls this down to deep midwicket
Long hop, really. Back of a length and at the stumps, rising at Inglis, and somehow he rises at this and lofts another drive down to deep extra cover.
Another good length delivery. Flicked from deep into the leg side and down to deep midwicket

Loses his shape on that one and doesn't pay too big a price, since the fielding restrictions are on. A good length at the stumps, pulled back shorter. Goes for another hoick across the line but lands past midwicket, no more
Now it's in the slot at the stumps again. Now Inglis just swipes this without moving deep into either side. Swipe into cow corner, simple as that

I don't have words for this shot. Let me try: he is deep in the leg side, and as the ball spears into the slot outside off, he throws his arms at this with a lofted inside-out drive. But he holds his shape and has so much power in those wrists, instead of falling over
Slower 'un speared in quite full. 121 kph. Dips at Mitch as he bends for this, and bunts it down to midwicket
On a length at the stumps, swiped across the line, down to deep midwicket
Full at the pads, driven down to mid-on. Two dot balls in a row. Gold dust, you suppose...
Better ball. Outside off, on a good full-ish length, driven down to covers
Too short, too wide, and a sound too sweet off Marsh's bat. This has been shovelled with a lofted drive, over deep extra cover once more... Hardly had to move there
Length ball converted into a yorker just outside off. Marsh ran down the pitch but couldn't middle this one, retreats into his crease

Another full toss, have a go at that... And so Marsh does. Now he swipes this from in front of his stumps and down to cow corner. We need a review and it looks like it's hit the ropes on the half-volley. Or it's hit the padding. You can't ever tell with these ones. Umpire deems it four. Play on.
Gift of a low full toss well outside off. Mitch Marsh considers this net batting. Easy drive hammered down to extra cover, thuds into the ropes

Huuuuge appeal, but the umpire is unmoved. Impeccable slower 'un, rifles into Inglis' pads as he goes for a huge hoick across the line to a length ball. Lost his shape completely. But RR settle down quickly, no review
On a length at the leg-stump line. Shovelled down to long on and they sneak in a run

Missed run out, there? Inglis can't stay still at his crease. Goes for a reverse scoop to a full-ish ball at the stumps. Edged down to leg gully, lying empty, keeper has a shy at the striker's stump and misses. Would've been out if he hit...
How has that flown over the ropes!? Was a poor ball, low full toss drifting down leg. Inglis crouches on his feet and just flat-bats a sweep over the deep fine leg ropes. That's ridiculous

And now he's deep in the leg side, goes after a full-ish ball at the stumps. Doesn't middle it by any stretch of the imagination, but has enough on it to land past two fielders running in near deep extra cover

Sandeep Sharma, how we've missed you. Straight up, he goes for that length ball on the stumps. Unfortunately for him, this is IPL cricket in 2026. Inglis doesn't move his feet to this knuckle ball and somehow swipes this fine, down to deep fine
Flies down to deep third. Inglis stepped out of the track to a length ball at the stumps. Wants to bash it over the bowler but can only get the edge in
Speared into the blockhole. Why not, it's Archer bowling 'em. At the stumps and keeps it down to a flick, down to midwicket
Now he goes for a big hoick but misses... Back of a length and at the stumps. Marsh runs down and goes for a huge pull but misses it

Who needs to middle it when you can time it like that... Flies off the bottom of Marsh's bat. Was back of a length and rising at his hips, at the stumps, but he just goes for a hoick and lands it past deep square leg
Inglis runs down again, doesn't middle it again. Dragged back in by a two-pair effort near cow corner. They run three, oof. Was a swipe across the line

Inglis goes for the pyrotechnics, and it pays off. Was full-ish on the stumps. Inglis jumps into the off side and scoops this over fine leg. Not middled but dribbles away to the ropes before fielders can get to it
Another yorker, right on the stumps this time. Glided down to deep backward point
Now he's missed the length. Back of a length and at the stumps, angling away from the right-hander. Boshed with a lofted drive over deep covers
He's picked a line and he's sticking to it, eh... Back to bowling it on a yorker length, at the wide tramline. He's inside it
Now that's the length. On a hard length and at the stumps. Inglis goes for another swipe across the line, along the ground, down to midwicket
He's finally landed one inside the wide marker. Only just, rearing off a fuller length. Inglis lets this one go
Yeah, he's trying to hide it outside the wide marker but it's not working. Reload again
That's absolutely outrageous. On a length, sits up in front of the stumps, Inglis just swivels on one leg and deposits this over deep square leg. Impeccable pull
That's a bit of nerves, innit... Spears this in on a length but goes wayyyy too wide outside off. Time to reload
He's perfected the recipe. Marsh runs down the track and boshes this back of a length delivery over the extra cover ropes once more...
'Tis is T20 cricket. Marsh runs down the track and boshes this over extra covers. Was a perfectly okay delivery but not with Marsh's long levers reaching for it
Would've been a stunner, but is a missed chance. Sushant runs back from midwicket to this mistimed pull, from Inglis. Caught him on the edge as the ball reared up from back of a length
Almost got him there... Back of a length, in the corridor outside off and moves away from Inglis' prod. Only swishes at air
Back of a length still, grips in the pitch just a little. Inglis swivels on his feet and pulls it right to midwicket
Oof, that's thudded into Marsh. Back of a length on the stumps, rising at the batter, who jumps at it but can't middle it
finished with a six over long-off and Rajasthan Royals go fourth on the points table with their first win in Jaipur this IPL!
dropped at long-on! Pooran it is and LSG's woes continue. Ferreira smashed it down to long on where Pooran got to it easily and had to take it around knee height, but it pops out
full and hint of with, drilled down to mid off where a dive makes it a dot
Prince is back to his yorkers and Jurel gets another one down to long on

heaved over fine leg and Jurel brings up a solid fifty off 36 balls. He was beaten by the pace of Prince a few times earlier, but times this one to perfection and punches the air while looking at the RR dugout
gets the flick wrong and the leading edge nearly carries back to Prince. Jurel has no idea where the ball is and takes off, but makes it back with a dive although Prince misses the direct hit
short of length and quick, pulled straight to midwicket
just misses off stump! Slow offcutter keeps a tad low and goes under Ferreira's heave
bashes the near-yorker down to long on and calls for two immediately
pulled away and Ferreira beats Prince in the deep with a one-bounce four! Bangs it into the pitch and Ferreira gave it the aerial treatment off the middle
Ferreira with the pull this time just wide of long on, and Jurel does extremely well to make it back for the second
slower ball is too short and cutting in, Jurel dismisses it with a pull square of the wicket where Prince does well with a tumble to save three
stifled appeal for lbw as Ferreira misses the big swing, not given out, not received, but it's a leg bye
another excellent yorker from Prince, he digs it out to long on for just one
late with the pull on the short ball, over midwicket for one
gets the yorker right again, outside off, and Jurel opens the face for a single to point but a misfield there leaks one more

loud appeal from Prince! That low full toss was quick to hit him on the pads around or outside leg, and not given. Prince wants a review, Pant says baahar hai (it's outside) but reviews it. No edge there and ball-tracking says that's missing leg
digs the yorker out to backward point, and oh my, Pretorius is gone by a mile! Direct hit by Badoni from behind the stumps, and Pretorius has his bat in the air because he's nowhere near getting in
hardly any room, he tries to carve it away but misses
pace off towards the pads, chipped down to long on and he keeps strike
some room for Jurel again, and another single carved to deep point
angling in from length, nudged to leg and one more
steers this wide delivery past point for one more
inside edge onto the pads as the ball nips in, a single to backward point
cutter into the pitch at 122.2kmh, turned to leg with soft hands for two more
worked off the back foot to long on to end the over with another single
one bounce to deep midwicket with a big pull off the back foot
outside off and he bashes it past the bowler to get off the mark
nudges the ball off his pads down to long on for one more
another little touch from Jurel, this one down to long on with soft hands
outside off and is squared up a bit, gets a quick double past point

that's it for Sooryavanshi for tonight! He has holed out to long on and Mohsin gets to celebrate not long after his faux pas. Slower one at 121kmh, he swings down town but doesn't get enough power in that Abdul Samad swallows it at long on. But he has knocked the daylights out of this chase. Gets a shower of applauses and pats on the back as he crosses the rope
short of length, turned from outside off to leg for one
some width and he carves it to cover
short ball slapped down to long on for one more

you cannot do that Mohsin Khan! Tapped to backward point and Jurel doesn't leave his crease but Sooryavanshi is more than halfway. Rathi throws it to Mohsin and he has all the time in the world, all the view of three stumps but misses! What luck for Sooryavanshi! And they run one finally. But Sooryavanshi is livid, says to Jurel it was his call

just wide of a diving Mitch Marsh at deep midwicket! Marsh had a few going his way when he skied while batting and the luck is with Sooryavanshi now. Pulls this away, can't get it all the way but the placement is good enough to beat Marsh for a one-bounce four. Into the 90s
goes for a slog sweep as this one's slowed down, but misses this time. Takes it on the pad
100.1kmh, too short and he's hammered that over wide long on! Flat delivery and a flat six in the big gap. Tenth six for him
gets a bottom edge towards mid off, Rathi goes across to make it another dot
fires it in outside off at 102.3kmh, swing and a miss this time
short and flat, mowed down to long on

doesn't matter if you place three in the deep on leg or 30, because Sooryavanshi has smoked that well and beyond the fence! 143kmh, short as well, and this 15-year-old doesn't cease to stun everyone. Really quick with his footwork to open up and what a horizontal swing of the arms
there's nobody at deep cover and what does he do with a full delivery? He clears his front foot, keeps his head down and carves that over the covers all the way!
slower ball into the pitch, Jurel waits and bashes it down to long on
and now the upper cut! He's being dispatched to all corners of the ground. Short and wide, a well-timed upper cut that goes all the way too
oh Jurel has the muscle too! A quick pivot on the back foot and there goes the ball over the midwicket fence
if Sooryavanshi had power, Jurel shows a classy straight drive straight back, all along the carpet to punish the full delivery
muscles that slower ball wayyyy over the stands! Keeps his weight on the back foot and absolutely demolishes that over midwicket after opening up. Fiftieth six for him this IPL!
dispatched over wide long off! Too full, enough room and Sooryavanshi frees his arms with a smacking drive inside out

wide yorker, he jams his bat down and that's caught at point. Looked like a bump ball but we got to check with the third umpire. Umpire's review. It was a low full toss and the ball went off the ground after hitting the bat
looks like that tailed in late, almost a yorker and jammed down to long on for one more
hint of width outside off and he carves it to deep point for one
slow, short and wide to the teenager, wide enough for an extra
bowls a heavy ball from short of length, Jurel's pull is a tad late, but gets one to long on
One final waft outside off, and he's clobbered this over deep covers. Was too wide, a little too short. Sooryavanshi gets on one knee and deposits this over extra cover
On a length, spins into his pads, and flicked down to mid-on
Helicopter cut, really. Huge, swivelly follow through to a ball kept on a length, well outside off. Stopped at covers
Back of a length outside off, spins into Jurel. He runs down and flicks it down to mid-on

Sooryavanshi brings up a 23-ball fifty! He gets there with a reverse sweep, and fine leg misfields. And guess what, Sooryavanshi gets in on the Quirky Celebrations Club! Looks like he formed an 'A' with his fingers there
On a length and spinning into the pads. Flicked down to backward square leg
Sooryavanshi rounds this over out with one final swipe down to long-on. Was in the slot once more. His eyes light up and he just opens up his front foot and tugs this one past the diving fielder
Another ball that's tooooo short. On a fifth-stump line and outside off.
On a length but toooo high. Time to reload once more
Enough top edges, now it's time for middling 'em. Sooryavanshi absolutely wipes this across the line. In the slot and is punished over deep midwicket
He is making merry in this over. Was on a length, well outside off. Sooryavanshi top-edges another big swipe across the line and the ball flies over to deep backward point
Back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi runs into the leg side and tries to bunt it away, but straight to covers
Rub of luck goes his way now. Was back of a length outside off, Sooryavanshi goes for another huge swing away from his body. Top edge runs down to deep third

Sooryavanshi, hope we haven't kept you waiting! He has been at the other end for a while now, and now he springs back into action with a big pull over deep square leg. Sat up at his chest and he just swipes this over the fielder who thought he might have had it for a couple of beats
Another quick 'un, 95 clicks. On a length and attacking the stumps, forcing Jurel to just play this out to covers
Straighter, quicker, and on the stumps! Jurel gets his bat down on time to defend this straight back
Slices backward point and point, through the gap, and to the ropes. A little too wide outside off, on a length. Gets on the backfoot and just sends this away with pinpoint accurate placement
On a length and outside off now, driven to covers
On a length, at the stumps, defended back to the right of the spinner
Too short, and Jurel swipes this long hop across the line. Pitched outside off, ended up thudding into the ropes at cow corner
Cut, quite late, down to deep backward point. Was on a length and kept outside off
On a length outside off. Bunted into the pitch
On a length and gliding quite far on the off side. Driven into the 'V', to cover

And finally, a batter succumbs to an ill-judged drive. Was on a good length outside off. Jaiswal misreads the length and goes for another big drive away from his body. Back to the keeper. Akash celebrates by raising one finger to the heavens, and his other hand taps his forehead. Big brain cricket, etc
Another booming drive, past backward point, and to the ropes. Too much width from outside off. And ah, a potential drop, but not a real chance because of how far he dived
On a length outside off, bunted down to point

Ungainly hoick but somehow he has got it down to long-on... Was short, once again, but Sooryavanshi almost flat-bats this swat through the line and straight as an arrow. He's playing tennis out there because why not
Yorker-ish and outside off. Driven out to covers without much timing
And now back to what he does best. Slot ball by Prince Yadav, outside off. Driven through the two cover fielders and rushes to the ropes

Sooryavanshi, the genius that you are. The bouncer has troubled him all season. This one is 140.6 clicks. Coming right at him. He gets out of the way and just subtly rolls his wrists on this ramp. Ball flies over deep third...
Low full toss, driven out to covers and Jaiswal takes off for the other end
Another waft outside off, swishing at air, by an RR batter. Was on a length and moving away from outside off
Sooryavanshi almost falls over in the crease. 147.7 clicks on a venomous bouncer, Sooryavanshi gets out of the way. Belatedly attempts a bunt over the keeper, but ball has already rocketed past him

And when Sooryavanshi lays bat on ball, this is what happens. Too full and outside off, all the pace on the ball now. He caresses a drive over extra cover, deep in his crease and those wrists flex themselves once more

Huge waft outside off but Sooryavanshi can't get bat on ball. Back of a length outside off, there to be hit, except Mayank deceives him in the air by slowwwing it down once more. Impeccable spell so far
Slow and back of a length. Moving away from Sooryavanshi, who can only drive this towards point
On the stumps and full-ish. Flicked down to mid-on
Woof, a pitch-perfect yorker. Right outside off and goes under Jaiswal's attempt at getting bat on ball, crouching into the crease
Now it's a slower 'un, and he drives this down to deep extra cover. Had to wait an extra beat for the ball to come to him. When it does, he drives it down with ease
Goes for another bunt through the covers but can't time this one. Straight to the fielder. Was there to be hit, wide outside off on a length

Jaiswal is just a puppet master right now. Ball was outside off and speared in shorter. But guess what, Jaiswal subtly moves into the off side, then plays this sooo late, guiding it between backward point and point
And now a sumptuous drive past two fielders stationed in the covers cordon. A little too wide, a little too full, and Jaiswal won't miss out on that
Timing. This is pure timing. Was on a length outside off, not even that bad a ball. Jaiswal just cuts this, late, down to deep point. Got on top of the bounce
Jaiswal launches this into the stands! Back of a length, rising at his hips without much venom. Jaiswal just flicks this fine and over long leg

And the bouncer almost does in Sooryavanshi again. 146.7 clicks, incredible pace as the ball just rises at him and cramps him up. Goes for a swivel pull and mistimes it completely. Lands between mid-off and mid-on
Full-ish and attacking the stumps. There to be driven, Sooryavanshi drives. But straight to covers
Now that's just batting smarts. Similar ball as the last one: width outside off. Sooryavanshi leans back and just cuts this so, so late with those immense wrists of his. Drilled past deep point
On a length but moving away from a fifth-stump line. Sooryavanshi goes for a big cut away from his body but can't connect
On a length but tucked into a leg-side line. Moving into the pads and Jaiswal flicks this to fine leg
Now that's quickkk - 144.2 clicks. Quite full and outside off. Jaiswal goes for a booming drive but can't connect
Sooryavanshi cautious in this one. Ball was on a great length just outside off, tailing back in. Sooryavanshi has to be content with just checking his drive, ball rockets to covers
On a length and moving into the batter again. Bunted down to point and they take off for a run
Another menacing bouncer, 136 clicks. Rears up at Jaiswal, whose hand comes off the bat grip as he jumps at this delivery and deadbats this into the pitch
Big swipe across the line but can't middle it. On a length and rising at him, he couldn't get under this delivery
On a length outside off, moves back in. Sooryavanshi drives this straight to covers
Wow, what's this from Sooryavanshi - an evasion! Ball was banged in quite short and quick, Sooryavanshi quite early on crouching deeep in his crease

The fielder at deep point has hung his head, and why not. Mayank Yadav receives a cut off a fairly ordinary ball, short and wide. He just lets this one burst through his hands. Poor cricket from LSG all around
On a length and rising at him, good bounce on the stumps and angled into the left-hander. Jaiswal misses the flick
And now Pant, behind the stumps, can't stop this one from drifting even further down leg. Past him. And to the ropes...
And now, a great ball. Speared in on a length, 132 clicks, and angled into the batter. Jaiswal can only defend it back to the bowler
Err, a wide now. On a length but wayyy down leg
Another loosener for the books. Was too short, still, and now right on the wide marker. Jaiswal deep in his crease again and just cuts this down to deep point
Even shorter, but still too innocuous. Jaiswal goes for another pull from right in front of his eyes and gets it down to long leg, now
Don't bowl there to Jaiswal, for sure. Was short but not short enough: rising at his chest but not much venom on this. Swivels at this, deep in his crease, pulled down to deep fine leg
Spears it in on a length but sliding down leg. The wide epidemic continues today
